scenarios.label: Cited RAG answer
scenarios.prompt: What did the team decide about the storage migration?

sources.snippet: Storage migration. We're at 71% on the shared tier.

events.text: In the platform sync the team
decided to move to a **dedicated database instance** rather than
prune the archive collection — Dev argued pruning only buys
about six weeks while migration solves it for the year.
They were at **71% of the shared tier's storage budget**. [platform-sync-transcript.txt 12:40, 15:02]

scenarios.label: Agent run with visible trace
scenarios.prompt: What was the fix for ERR-8821-C and is it verified?

events.text: **Fix:** a clock-skew guard in the lease manager, shipped in
**v3.7.20-rc.1** — a follower could previously renew a read lease after the
leader had granted a write lease for the same page.
**Verified:** post-deploy metrics show read skew back under 0.1% on west-2,
and Marcus closed the action item in the sync. The two-replica lease test still needs an Atlas run. [platform-reliability-report.txt]

scenarios.label: Ask-your-data chart
scenarios.prompt: How did error budget consumption trend over the quarter?

events.text: Error-budget consumption **peaked in September at 41%** (driven by ERR-8821-C)
and improved sharply to **22% in October** after the lease-manager fix shipped.
Median latency also improved from 240ms to 186ms over the same period.

| Month | Budget consumed | Median latency |
|---|---|---|
| Jul | 38% | 240ms |
| Aug | 31% | 215ms |
| Sep | 41% | 198ms |
| Oct | 22% | 186ms |
